gloss: feel to the touch; texture (of fabric); how something feels on the skin

definitions.gloss: feel to the touch; texture against the skin
definitions.explanation: How a material or surface feels when it touches the skin, especially regarding fabric and clothing.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{肌触|はだざわ}りがいい。
examples.english: This shirt feels nice against the skin.

examples.japanese: シルクの{肌触|はだざわ}りが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the feel of silk against my skin.

examples.japanese: {肌触|はだざわ}りの{良|よ}いタオルを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a towel with a nice texture.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{肌|はだ} (skin) + {触|さわ}り (touching, feel) → feel against skin

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{肌触|はだざわ}りがいい / {良|よ}い (feels nice on the skin)
・{肌触|はだざわ}りが{悪|わる}い (feels rough/unpleasant)
・{肌触|はだざわ}りの{良|よ}い{素材|そざい} (material with good texture)
・さらさらした{肌触|はだざわ}り (smooth, silky feel)

RELATED ～{触|ざわ}り / ～{触|さわ}り WORDS:
・{手触|てざわ}り (how something feels to the hand)
・{舌触|したざわ}り (how something feels on the tongue)
・{耳障|みみざわ}り (harsh on the ears - note different meaning)

USAGE NOTE:
{肌触|はだざわ}り is important in Japanese product descriptions for clothing, bedding, and towels, where texture against the skin is highly valued.
